rationale_highlights: Between the ages of five and 13 he was in a residential school and he was physically and sexually abused there, including by a priest.
These factors can play a role in reducing the moral culpability of the offender, which mitigates the sentence that would otherwise be imposed.
Mr. Phillips's background could not be a clearer specific example of the harmful experiences that have been endured by aboriginal persons
They reduce Mr. Phillips' moral blameworthiness and will have a mitigating effect on the sentence I would otherwise have imposed.
